facts.text: The image is a multi-panel character reference sheet with a large cinematic panel at the top, three full-body turnaround panels in the middle, and four close-up detail panels along the bottom.
The top panel shows a rain-soaked elevated walkway at night, with metal railings on both sides, wet reflective paving, falling rain, and blurred city lights and buildings in the background.
In the top panel, a single person stands centered on the walkway wearing a black collared jacket, a dark shirt, black trousers, and black boots.
The middle row contains three full-body views of the same person on a plain dark studio background, labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK; the person stands upright with arms relaxed at the sides.
The person has short dark hair with shaved sides and a small topknot, visible in the top, side-profile, back, and face panels.
The FACE panel is a close-up of the person with a neutral expression and a direct gaze toward the camera.
The JACKET COLLAR panel shows a close-up of black jacket fabric with a zipper and a rectangular buckle and strap.
The HANDS panel shows two bare hands with visible knuckles, finger creases, and dark smudges on the skin.
The BOOTS panel shows black lace-up combat boots with scuffed leather and thick soles.
Legible panel labels in the image are HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.

card.summary: A dark, cinematic character reference sheet presenting one person in all-black tactical clothing, with a rainy night hero scene at the top, front/side/back turnaround views in the middle, and close-up details of the face, jacket collar, hands, and boots at the bottom.

card.environment: Top panel: rainy urban elevated walkway at night with metal railings and blurred city lights. Turnaround and detail panels: plain dark gray studio backdrop.
card.lighting: Top panel: low-key night lighting with cool blue rain and warm amber streetlights. Studio panels: dim, soft directional light with deep shadows.
card.framing: Multi-panel reference sheet: one wide full-body hero shot at the top; three full-body turnaround views labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK in the middle; four detail close-ups labeled FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS along the bottom.
card.style: Photorealistic cinematic character-design sheet with a dark, gritty mood.

limitations: Some fine clothing and skin details are obscured by deep shadows and the dark color scheme.
